market.question: Will the highest temperature in Taipei be 31°C on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: Taipei forecast ~29°C high (84°F) for May 2. Bracket 31°C is two degrees above forecast; possible with sun exposure but less likely than 28-30°C range. Probability ~0.13. Market 0.275 may be overpricing.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sun versus cloud cover and inland heating
